title: EmbeddingGemma 2: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
summary: Google announces EmbeddingGemma 2, an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model aimed at developers. The release targets efficient embedding generation across text and other modalities, positioning it as a practical tool for retrieval, search, and RAG pipelines. Discussion on Hacker News drew significant interest, reflecting demand for compact, open embedding models that can run with modest compute.
